adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `posts.cook_method` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb). This verifiably bypasses the normal cooking pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`) and also skips `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` for those posts. The new import paths explicitly set `cook_method: :raw_html` (TopicEmbed.import via PostCreator), and the RSS poller passes `i.content` through largely unsanitized (jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), so imported content can be served as already-cooked HTML without Discourse’s usual sanitization/cooking behavior—creating a concrete security/correctness risk for those posts (even if not for all posts by default).
